name: Hotel Frohnatur
beschreibung: The Hotel Frohnatur is located in the municipality of Thiersee in Austrian Tirol. The hotel's surroundings are characterized by the mountain world of the Alpen. Nearby are the ski areas Zahmer Kaiser and Wilder Kaiser. The amenities include rooms with balcony, a sauna area, and a restaurant serving regional cuisine. The hotel offers a quiet atmosphere. Hiking trails and cross-country ski trails are accessible in the surrounding area. Thiersee invites you to take walks. The accommodation is used by nature and activity holidaymakers.
